tasks.short: Develop sustainability reports for outside groups.

steps.what: List stored rows for sustainability reports
Outline sustainability reports for outside groups
Draft sustainability reports from stored rows

loop.purpose: Draft the report from stored ledger rows and the officer's outline.
loop.input: Stored ledger rows and the outline.
loop.output: Report prose in which every figure cites a ledger row.
loop.check: Every figure matches a stored ledger row.
loop.stop: Stop when a figure has no ledger row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A blank report cannot judge whether a reporting duty applies.

steps.what: Develop presentations and proposals for groups
Sign reports for public interest groups
Send the signed sustainability reports
outputs: filed copy of signed sustainability report v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored rows in {ERP}. The officer outlines the sustainability reports, presentations, and proposals for supplier, employee, academia, media, government, public interest, or other groups. A bounded draft uses only those rows and that outline, and stops when a figure has no row. The officer checks the draft, holds editorial responsibility, and signs. A later job sends that signed version from {EMAIL}. It does not post an unsigned text.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports were rewritten from memory, and a figure could appear with no ledger row.
tasks.enabler_now: The figures already sit on the ledger.
tasks.still_hard: The audience and the duty to report still need the officer.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides what each group is told and signs the text.

ambition.what: Send a signed report to a group the week the ledger closes.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the audience, not on retyping figures.

reach.learn: Which group the text is for

evidence.claim: Digest [S1] is cited for drafts whose figures come from the system of record and which the owner signs.
Digest [S16] records a report that cited non-existent references and a fabricated court case, so a line with no stored source is dropped.
Digest [S12] says public-interest text needs a label unless a person reviews it and holds editorial responsibility, and Digest [S11] dates that duty from 2 August 2026.
Digest [S7] says human oversight was required at all times in that trial, and this design does not use the reported minutes as its own saving.

assumptions: Every figure comes from a stored row.
The officer holds editorial responsibility before any send.
Configure the existing ledger before a new store.
unknowns: Which groups count as public interest.
Whether a reporting duty applies this period.
research_questions: How often a requested figure has no ledger row.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining review time is still the officer checking the text.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many figures lack a row. The high end assumes the ledger rows are complete. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop outreach media for sustainability events.

steps.what: List stored facts for sustainability events
Develop marketing media for sustainability projects
Oversee outreach media for project events
Sign the outreach media for events
File the signed outreach media
outputs: filed copy of signed outreach media v1

tasks.design: A job lists stored event facts in {PROJECT}. The officer develops, or oversees, the marketing and outreach media for sustainability projects and events. A later job files the signed media in {DOCS}. The job does not generate the media text and does not post it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event facts were copied into a fresh brief before the media was written.
tasks.enabler_now: The event record already holds the date, place, and project.
tasks.still_hard: The message still depends on the audience.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides what the media says.
tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the media, not on chasing event facts.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.

assumptions: Configure the existing event record before a new store.
unknowns: Who may post the signed media.
research_questions: How often an event has no stored date.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining media time is still the officer writing.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes event facts are missing. The high end assumes event facts are already stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify and evaluate sustainability pilot projects.

steps.what: List stored sustainability research agenda items
Identify pilot projects to enhance research
Evaluate pilot programs against the agenda
Sign the pilot evaluation
File the signed pilot evaluation
outputs: filed copy of signed pilot evaluation v1

tasks.design: A job lists the stored research agenda in {DOCS}. The officer identifies and evaluates pilot projects or programs to enhance that sustainability research agenda. A later job files the signed evaluation in {DOCS}. A model does not start a pilot.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agenda was a slide, and pilots were picked in the room with no list.
tasks.enabler_now: The agenda items are already written down.
tasks.still_hard: A pilot can fit the agenda and still be the wrong bet.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides which pilot is worth trying.

ambition.what: Judge a pilot against the stored agenda before the project is opened.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the pilot choice, not on finding the agenda.

reach.task: Open only the pilot the note names
reach.learn: Which agenda item the pilot serves

evidence.claim: The executive digest says strategy, direction, approvals, campaigns, and risk assessments stay manual, and there is no agent.

assumptions: The agenda is a stored list.
A pilot starts only after the officer signs.
unknowns: Which agenda items are still open.
research_questions: How often a proposed pilot has no agenda item.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining identification time is still the officer's choice.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes the agenda is thin. The high end assumes the agenda is already stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Total stored amounts for program budgets
Create sustainability program schedules
Maintain sustainability program documents
Sign the program budget and schedule
File the signed program budget
outputs: filed copy of signed program budget v1

tasks.design: A job totals stored budget amounts in {ERP}. The officer creates and maintains the sustainability program documents, including schedules and budgets, in the existing {PROJECT} record. The schedule is program dates, not a roster of named people. A later job files the signed budget in {DOCS}. Digest [S3] timing is not this design's saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budgets were retyped into a fresh sheet and mailed around for a merge.
tasks.enabler_now: The amounts already sit on the ledger.
tasks.still_hard: A budget can be complete and still be the wrong plan.
tasks.human_edge: The officer decides the schedule and the budget.

ambition.what: Update the program budget the week the ledger totals post.

tasks.altitude: The officer spends the week on the plan, not on merging sheets.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a recurring review is a dashboard on the ledger, and Digest [S2] says unprepared data gives inaccurate answers, so every cited number is checked against stored rows.
Digest [S3] is a vendor case the digest treats as integration rather than a model, so this design does not use that timing as its own saving.

assumptions: Configure the existing planning record before a new system.
No named person is scheduled or scored.
unknowns: Who else must sign a budget.
research_questions: How often a program has no stored budget row.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining planning time is still the officer's budget judgement.

incremental.description: Remap ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear a figure the job cannot trace.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes budget rows are late. The high end assumes budget rows are on the ledger. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The sustainability officer spends the week on the strategy, the risk, and the signed text. A total from stored rows and filing that text can move. No model approves a project or scores a person.
reach: A supplier receives only the report version the officer signed.
A project lead starts only from the proposal the officer approved.
skills_to_grow: Reject a figure that has no row in the ledger.
Check whether a reporting duty applies before a report is called a filing.
role.ambitious_version: A signed impact report can go out the same week, and the officer still holds the text.
